title: Hindu College Staff Association protests against administration in Delhi

tea.why: Staff protest against alleged financial, administrative, and admission irregularities by the college administration.
tea.want: Removal of the principal and governing body chairman, an independent inquiry, and Delhi University intervention.
tea.changed: Oct 14: The Hindu College Staff Association stated it has been staging a dharna for over two weeks.

summary: The Hindu College Staff Association (HCSA) has been staging a protest and dharna against the college administration, demanding the removal of the college principal and the governing body chairman. Organised by the HCSA, the demonstration began following allegations of irregularities in admissions, financial procurement, and governance, as well as the commercial use of college resources and safety concerns. The association has called for an independent inquiry, the temporary takeover of the college by Delhi University, the withdrawal of show-cause notices issued to faculty members, and the implementation of Comptroller and Auditor General observations. According to the association, memorandums have been submitted to the university vice-chancellor and the governing body without an effective response, while political figures have addressed the protesting participants in solidarity.
demands: Remove the college principal and governing body chairman
Conduct an independent inquiry into alleged irregularities
Intervention and temporary takeover by Delhi University
Withdrawal of show-cause notices issued to faculty members
Implementation of Comptroller and Auditor General observations
response: The Hindu College Staff Association stated that it had submitted memorandums to the university's vice-chancellor and the governing body but had received no effective response.

updates.text: The protest began following allegations of rule violations in sports and ECA quota admissions.
The Hindu College Staff Association stated it had been staging a dharna for over two weeks.
